clue: A map of equipotential lines + "which way does it move?"
tool: $\vec E \perp$ lines, high → low $V$; **flip for negative** charges

clue: "Where is the field strongest?" on an equipotential map
tool: Lines **closest together**

clue: "A free negative/positive charge tends to move…"
tool: Positive charges move to lower $V$; negative charges to higher $V$

clue: Rod, ring, disk + "potential"
tool: $V = \int K\,dq/r$, then $\vec E = -\nabla V$ if needed

clue: "Capacitance of" a sphere, cylinder, or plates
tool: 4-step recipe: $Q$ → Gauss → $\Delta V$ → $C = Q/\Delta V$

clue: Dielectric fills **part** of a capacitor
tool: **Single-field-line test**: series or parallel pieces

clue: Plates moved / dielectric inserted / "energy changes?"
tool: **Connected (V fixed) or isolated (Q fixed)?**

clue: Wires of different lengths and areas, stretching, squashing
tool: $R = \rho L/A$; reshaping keeps **volume** constant

clue: Several resistors, "smallest/largest equivalent"
tool: Series adds; parallel is **smaller than the smallest**

clue: Multiple batteries in different branches
tool: Kirchhoff (loops + junctions) or the node-voltage shortcut

clue: "How much power does the circuit use?"
tool: $\sum I^2R$ over resistors = **net** battery power

clue: A capacitor in a circuit, "long time" / "fully charged"
tool: Capacitor = **gap**; its $\Delta V$ = voltage of whatever it's parallel to

clue: A charged drop/grain is "suspended," "floats," "levitates"
tool: $\lvert q\rvert E = mg$ with $E = \Delta V/d$

clue: "Switch closes at $t = 0$"
tool: $t = 0^+$: $C$ = wire. $t\to\infty$: $C$ = gap. $\tau = R_{\text{eq}}C_{\text{eq}}$

clue: "At what time is the **energy** at a fraction of max?"
tool: $U \propto q^2$ → convert to a **charge** fraction ($\sqrt f$), then use logs

clue: Several long wires + "direction of $\vec B$ at P"
tool: Right-hand rule per wire; $\vec B \perp$ (wire→P line); **add vectors**

clue: Bent wire with arcs and straight pieces
tool: Building blocks + **zero rule** for pieces pointing at P

clue: Slab, sheet, thick wire, coax, "current density varies with…"
tool: **Ampère** with a symmetric loop; $I_{\text{enc}} = \int J\,dA$

clue: "Line integrals around these paths"
tool: $I_{\text{enc}}$ with **signs** from the loop's right-hand rule

clue: "Force/torque is greatest/least when…"
tool: $\sin\theta$: 0 when parallel, max when perpendicular

clue: Charged ball on a string, circle, in a magnetic field
tool: $\vec v\times\vec B$ direction → **flip if negative** → inward/outward → radial $F = mv^2/r$

clue: Loop or rod near a long wire, "net force"
tool: $I\vec L\times\vec B$ per side; **cancel by symmetry**; integrate if $B$ varies along a side; **Newton's 3rd**

clue: Strip with current + $\vec B$ + "$\Delta V$ across it" / "sign of carriers"
tool: **Hall recipe** (assume positive → which edge → compare sign)
